_comment: Red-team / safety regression set for the input guardrails (services/orchestration_service/regex_guardrails.py). Used by BOTH tests/test_guardrails.py (every case must pass) and evaluation/quality_gate.py (block-rate, false-positive-rate and PII-recall are gated in CI). expect: 'block' (must be refused, with the given check), 'allow' (genuine legal question — blocking it is a false positive), 'redact' (allowed, but the listed placeholder tokens must appear in the sanitized question). The 'benign_tricky' cases are real citizen questions that share vocabulary with attacks (police, escape, system, fake...) and exist specifically to catch over-eager regexes.
